overview: Studying Civil Engineering - UG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Civil Engineering in Finland after 12th?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply directly for English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Civil Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: LUT University lists an annual tuition fee of €12,000 (approx. ₹13.03 lakh). Eligible international students who confirm their place promptly can claim a €2,000 first-year early-bird discount.

faq.question: Is Civil Engineering taught in English in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. LUT University offers its complete Bachelor

faq.question: What subjects are important for Civil Engineering admission in Finland?
faq.answer: Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry are the core subjects required in Class 12. Strong performance in these subjects and English proficiency are key to admission.
